meta.title: Peak/off-peak and holidays
meta.description: Warns above the sidebar account only when holidays are not configured for the required years (hidden once configured), and shows peak/off-peak hours with a colon before the reason (weekend, holiday, or time) in the composer's left control area, left of the model selector without taking width from the model name. Both use the same tag shape and font as 1017; peak is yellow, off-peak green.
